20: newTalent{
21: 	name = "Arcane Amplification Drone Effect", image = "talents/arcane_amplification_drone.png",
22: 	type = {"spell/other", 1},
23: 	mode = "passive",
24: 	points = 1,
25: 	callbackOnTakeDamage = function(self, t, src, x, y, type, dam, tmp)
26: 		if dam <= 0 or src ~= self.summoner then return {dam=0} end
27: 
28: 		local source_talent = src.__projecting_for and src.__projecting_for.project_type and (src.__projecting_for.project_type.talent_id or src.__projecting_for.project_type.talent) and src.getTalentFromId and src:getTalentFromId(src.__projecting_for.project_type.talent or src.__projecting_for.project_type.talent_id)
29: 		if not source_talent or not source_talent.is_spell then return {dam=0} end
30: 
31: 		self:project({type="ball", range=0, radius=4}, self.x, self.y, function(px, py)
32: 			local a = game.level.map(px, py, Map.ACTOR)
33: 			if a and a ~= self and a ~= src then
34: 				DamageType:get(DamageType.ARCANE).projector(self, a.x, a.y, DamageType.ARCANE, dam * 1.3)
35: 			end
36: 		end)
37: 		game.level.map:particleEmitter(self.x, self.y, 4, "generic_sploom", {rm=150, rM=180, gm=20, gM=60, bm=180, bM=200, am=80, aM=150, radius=2, basenb=120})
38: 		return {dam=0}
39: 	end,
40: 	info = function(self, t)
41: 		return (_t[[Spell damage done to it ripples in radius 4 doing 130% arcane damage.]])
42: 	end,
43: }

45: uberTalent{
46: 	name = "Arcane Amplification Drone",
47: 	require = { special={desc=_t"Have gained the #{italic}#Tales of the Spellblaze#{normal}# achievement with this or any previous character for the current difficulty & permadeath settings.", fct=function(self)
48: 		local id = world:getCurrentAchievementDifficultyId(game, "SPELLBLAZE_LORE")
49: 		return world:hasAchievement(id)
50: 	end} },
51: 	cooldown = 10,
52: 	no_npc_use = true,
53: 	no_energy = true,
54: 	range = 7,
55: 	callbackOnChangeLevel = function(self, t, mode, zone, level)
56: 		if not level or mode ~= "leave" then return end
57: 		for uid, e in pairs(level.entities) do
58: 			if e.is_amplification_drone and e.summoner == self then e:disappear() end
59: 		end
60: 	end,	
61: 	action = function(self, t)
62: 		local tg = {type="bolt", nowarning=true, range=self:getTalentRange(t), nolock=true, simple_dir_request=true, talent=t}
63: 		local tx, ty, target = self:getTarget(tg)
64: 		if not tx or not ty then return nil end
65: 		local _ _, _, _, tx, ty = self:canProject(tg, tx, ty)
66: 		target = game.level.map(tx, ty, Map.ACTOR)
67: 		if target == self then target = nil end
68: 
69: 		-- Find space
70: 		local x, y = util.findFreeGrid(tx, ty, 5, true, {[Map.ACTOR]=true})
71: 		if not x then
72: 			game.logPlayer(self, "Not enough space to summon!")
73: 			return
74: 		end
75: 
76: 		local NPC = require "mod.class.NPC"
77: 		local m = NPC.new{
78: 			type = "construct", subtype = "mechanical",
79: 			display = "*", color=colors.UMBER,
80: 			name = _t"arcane amplification drone", faction = self.faction, image = "npc/construct_mechanical_arcane_amplification_drone.png",
81: 			resolvers.nice_tile{tall=1},
82: 			desc = _t[[Any spell damage you deal to it will ripple around in radius 4 as 160% arcane damage.]],
83: 			autolevel = "none",
84: 			ai = "summoned", ai_real = "dumb_talented", ai_state = { talent_in=1, },
85: 			level_range = {1, 1}, exp_worth = 0,
86: 
87: 			max_life = 100, life_regen = 100,
88: 			hated_by_summoner = 1,
89: 			life_rating = 0,
90: 			never_move = 1,
91: 			never_act = 1,
92: 			combat_armor = 0, combat_def = 0,
93: 			is_amplification_drone = true,
94: 
95: 			resolvers.talents{
96: 				[self.T_ARCANE_AMPLIFICATION_DRONE_EFFECT] = 1,
97: 			},
98: 
99: 			summoner = self, summoner_gain_exp=true,
100: 			summon_time = 3,
101: 			resists_pen = table.clone(self.resists_pen or {}, true),
102: 		}
103: 
104: 		m:resolve() m:resolve(nil, true)
105: 		m:forceLevelup(self.level)
106: 		-- if core.shader.active(4) then m:addParticles(Particles.new("shader_ring_rotating", 1, {toback=true, rotation=0, radius=2, img="arcanegeneric", a=0.7}, {type="sunaura", time_factor=5000}))
107: 		-- else m:addParticles(Particles.new("ultrashield", 1, {rm=180, rM=220, gm=10, gM=50, bm=190, bM=220, am=120, aM=200, radius=0.4, density=100, life=8, instop=20}))
108: 		-- end
109: 
110: 		game.zone:addEntity(game.level, m, "actor", x, y)
111: 		game.level.map:particleEmitter(x, y, 1, "summon")
112: 		return true
113: 	end,
114: 	info = function(self, t)
115: 		return ([[You create an Arcane Amplification Drone at the selected location for 3 turns.
116: 		When you cast a spell that damages the drone it will ripple the damage as 130%% arcane damage of the initial hit in radius 4.]])
117: 		:tformat()
118: 	end,
119: }

124: 		birth_descriptors={{"subclass", "Archmage"}},

130: 	is_technomancy = true, is_steam = true, is_spell = true,
131: 	mode = "passive",
132: 	no_npc_use = true,
133: 	on_learn = function(self, t)
134: 		if not game.party:hasMember(self) then return end
135: 		self.descriptor.class_evolution = _t"Technomancer"
136: 
137: 		self:learnTalentType("spell/galvanic-technomancy", false)

139: 
140: 		self:learnTalentType("spell/terrene-technomancy", false)
141: 		self:setTalentTypeMastery("spell/terrene-technomancy", 1.3)
142: 
143: 		self:learnTalentType("spell/occult-technomancy", false)
144: 		self:setTalentTypeMastery("spell/occult-technomancy", 1.3)
145: 
146: 		self:learnTalentType("steamtech/physics", true)
147: 		self:learnTalentType("steamtech/chemistry", false)
148: 		self:learnTalent(self.T_SMITH, true)
149: 		self:learnTalent(self.T_MECHANICAL, true, 2)
150: 		self:learnTalent(self.T_ELECTRICITY, true, 2)
151: 		self:incSteam(100)
152: 
153: 		if self ~= game:getPlayer(true) then return end
154: 		
155: 		-- From now on, drop tinker stuff
156: 		game.state.birth.merge_tinkers_data = true
157: 
158: 		game.party:learnTinker("ARCANE_DYNAMO")
159: 
160: 		local ape = self:findInAllInventoriesBy("define_as", "APE")

164: 			local o = game.zone:makeEntityByName(game.level, base_list, "APE", true)

167: 				self:addObject(self.INVEN_INVEN, o)

170: 		end

173: 			{name=_t"Occult Technomancy", type="spell/occult-technomancy", talent=self.T_METATEMPORAL_SPINNER, desc=_t[[These talents focus on arcane and temporal damage, using a super-spinned steamsaw to rip holes in reality.]]},
174: 			{name=_t"Galvanic Technomancy", type="spell/galvanic-technomancy", talent=self.T_GALVANIC_ROD, desc=_t[[These talents focus on fire and lightning damage, strategically placing galvanic rods to create fields of death and stuns.]]},
175: 			{name=_t"Terrene Technomancy", type="spell/terrene-technomancy", talent=self.T_MICRO_SPIDERBOT, desc=_t[[These talents focus on cold and physical damage, summoning micro spiderbots to harass and pin their foes or protect themselves.]]},
176: 		}
177: 		local d = require("engine.ui.Dialog"):listPopup(_t"Technomancer", _t"Choose your free Technomancy unlock?", list, 400, 250, function(sel)
178: 			if not sel then return end
179: 			self:learnTalentType(sel.type)
